facts.assertion: Havering's current Local Plan was adopted in 2021.
The Havering Local Plan update page identifies Reviewing and collecting evidence as the current update stage.
Havering says every Local Plan policy must be properly evidenced and evidence-base documents sit alongside the plan.
Havering says new evidence-base documents will be published as they are produced.
The update evidence base includes the Havering Character Study and four appendices.
The update evidence base includes an Employment Land Review and Cluster Summary appendix.
The update evidence base includes the Havering Archaeological Priority Areas Report.
The update evidence base includes a Strategic Housing Market Assessment.
The update evidence base includes an Open Space Assessment.
The update evidence base includes Indoor Sports needs assessment plus Strategy and Action Plan.
The update evidence base includes Playing Pitch and Outdoor Sports needs assessment plus Strategy and Action Plan.
The update evidence base includes the Retail and Town Centre Study with capacity, health-check and household-survey volumes.
Havering's current Local Development Scheme was approved in April 2025 and covers 2025-2027.
Havering's weekly planning page currently lists applications received from 14 to 20 July 2026.
Havering publishes a new-applications list every Tuesday covering the previous seven days.
Application P0380.26 at David Lloyd, Squirrels Heath Lane, Gidea Park was approved with conditions on 13 July 2026.
P0380.26 concerns an external spa garden with sauna, hydro pools, plunge pools and associated facilities; it is not a Local Plan allocation decision.
Application P1349.25 at 9 Hare Hall Lane remained Undecided on the current planning record despite a Decision By date of 14 July 2026.
Havering's adopted Local Plan and Policies Map were adopted on 17 November 2021 and replaced the 2008 Core Strategy/Development Control policies and Romford Area Action Plan from that date.
Havering's planning search service distinguishes application search, decision search and appeal search; these operational records are separate from Local Plan allocation evidence.
